query: Build search keyword clusters for facility rentals and run a content gap analysis.
expected_behavior: Gathers candidate keywords and pulls real query data from Search Console where possible rather than inventing volumes
Clusters terms by search intent (informational / commercial / transactional) and maps each cluster to a target page
Surfaces quick wins (page-2 / position 11-20 queries) and gaps (intents with no page yet) as distinct sections
Resolves Drive or Confluence before drafting, publishes the keyword map there, and returns the exact durable URL, review state, owner, approver, target surface, Jira key, assets, and website handoff
Uses one unique scratch workspace and removes it on success and failure; stays git-free and hands quick wins to tron:landing-page-seo using the approved-source URL
